change.detail: Removed cherry_tx_kick() from the CDC ACM bulk-in completion callback so that the next IN transfer would be started only by usb_lld_poll_rtt().

hypothesis: Breaking completion-callback-to-next-transfer chaining might reduce CherryUSB/DWC2 TX reentrancy and improve long-tail CDC stability.

comparison.d49_effect: Deferring all next-transfer kicks to poll starved high-rate MAVLink streams even though heartbeat and GDB remained alive.
comparison.risk: The change moves CDC transmit progress from completion-driven to poll-driven scheduling and loses throughput under ArduPilot stream load.

revert.restore_note: The first restore run later showed MAV_STATE_CRITICAL with stack_ovrflw text; rebuilding and reflashing the same D47 source restored STANDBY and GREEN, so D49 source was not retained.

decision.reason: 30 s fast-green failed with very low RAW_IMU/ATTITUDE/EKF/SCALED_PRESSURE counts, while no HardFault was present. This is a throughput regression, not a stability fix.
decision.followup: Do not remove completion callback chaining. Continue USB long-tail work from D47 only after a fresh build-flash-MAVLink-GDB baseline is GREEN.
